summary: The agent was asked to split routing optimization and security-policy tightening on R1 into parallel work, then reconcile. It made two separate changes to the router's state: it replaced static routes for 172.16.0.0/12 and 10.50.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.254, then narrowed the eth1->eth2 forward rule to TCP 80/443 and UDP 53 and committed it with fw-commit. The trace shows no reconciliation step, so the new routes may carry traffic that the tightened firewall now drops.
